notes.title: Discover Aveliana: Exclusive Developer Insights Live Stream!
notes.content:
Heroes and heroines, mark your calendars for an extraordinary event! Join us for an exclusive live stream with Romain the developer of Aveliana.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38800424/697f0833042ee938fc4dda3afa87a09fa3949386.png[/img]

📅 [b]Date & Time: February 7, 2024 at 7:00 PM CET (Central European Time)[/b]

⏰ [b]Time in Other Zones:[/b]
- 🕒 1:00 PM EDT (Eastern Daylight Time)
- 🕒 12:00 PM CDT (Central Daylight Time)
- 🕒 11:00 AM MDT (Mountain Daylight Time)
- 🕒 10:00 AM PDT (Pacific Daylight Time)

🔗 Watch Live on Steam

🎙 [b]Hosts:[/b] Romain the developper of Aveliana!

✨ [b]What's in Store:[/b]

1️⃣ [b]Insider's Journey:[/b] Take a deep dive into the making of Aveliana as the developers guide you through the inspirations, challenges, and exciting moments encountered during the development process.

2️⃣ [b]Live Gameplay Demonstration:[/b] Witness the magic unfold as the developers showcase live gameplay, unveiling secrets, and showcasing the awe-inspiring world that Aveliana has to offer.

3️⃣ [b]Community Interaction:[/b] Join in the conversation! Engage with fellow gamers, share your thoughts, and be part of the Aveliana community during the live stream.

4️⃣ [b]Behind-the-Scenes Sneak Peek:[/b] Get an exclusive look behind the curtain with never-before-seen concept art, early designs, and a glimpse into the creative process that brought Aveliana to life.

🌐  [b]Connect with me[/b]

Stay connected and receive live updates leading up to the event:
- Twitter: https://twitter.com/TheFrenchDev_

Prepare to embark on a journey like never before as we unravel the mysteries of Aveliana together. Save the date, rally your friends, and get ready for an unforgettable live stream with the developer himself!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Live Stream!
notes.content:
On the 17th of June at 6pm (GMT+2, paris local time), I will play Aveliana's demo live for the Next Fest! Join me and let your friends know about this event. You will be able to ask me anything about the game dev.

It will be a unique opportunity for you to discover the game and more about how I make it, what are my inspirations, what other games I love, etc. I will discuss the pieces of gameplay I have created, the art style, and what makes the game original and unique. I'm looking forward to talking with you about all of this!

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426740/Aveliana/]Click here to PLAY THE DEMO[/url][/h2]
In the meantime, you can[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426740/Aveliana/] play the first demo of Aveliana [/url]that I have uploaded on the Steam game page! Feel free to give me feedback as it is still an alpha version of the game.

If you want to see the last video I have made on Aveliana, it is here:
[previewyoutube=eJW3LGe0iMg;full][/previewyoutube]

Follow the game progress on [url=https://twitter.com/TheFrenchDev_]Twitter[/url]
Have a good day!
